body.description: Toastlet: a small chrome pop-up toaster creature, two bread slots on top glowing hot orange inside, a lever on its side like a stubby arm, two little feet, mischievous eyes on its front panel, crumbs and scorch marks; ambush predator. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
